title: Perplexity's Ad Strategy: Comet Was Given Away, Computer Is Sold
summary: 85% of Perplexity's live Meta ads sell Computer. Comet was given away: 89% say free, 6-day median life. Computer: 5% free, 24 task landers.
body_markdown:
Companies buy Perplexity for search. Ramp's October 2026 AI category data names it the most-purchased Search and Research AI vendor, bought by 95% of that category's buyers.


Its ads sell something else. 85% of the Meta ads running right now sell Computer. "Introducing Computer" is the headline on 356 of Perplexity's 1,775 Meta ads. Search gets 15% of the live ads.


And the two launches ran opposite trades. Comet, the browser, was given away: 89% of its ads say free, and none are live. Computer is being sold: 5% say free, and 334 are live.


Two launches, a year apart. 910 ads in September and October 2025, 833 of them for the Comet browser. 381 in August and September 2026, 332 of them for Computer. Between them, a trickle.


## Perplexity ads: key findings


- **507** live Meta ads as of 13 October 2026, out of at least **1,775** run since April 2025
- **85%** of live Meta ads sell Computer; **15%** sell search
- **356** ads headline "Introducing Computer"; **508** mention Computer in the headline, copy or lander
- Comet was given away: **89%** of **836** Comet ads say free, the median ad ran **6 days** , none are live
- Computer is sold: **5%** of **508** ads say free, all in English, **334** live, the median ended ad ran **39 days**
- **166** ads send people to a task lander under /gen/, across **24** different jobs
- **578** ads go to a perplexity.sng.link app deep link
- Comet campaigns are split by objective: **110** ads buy the download, **39** buy the first query
- **23** creators had a Meta campaign named after them in the Comet launch
- **284** of 391 live Meta ads route through one attribution deep link
- Referrals are paid through Dub, reported at **$15** per US Comet download that asks a first question
- **173** ads run on partner and creator pages, **66** different pages
- **292** Spanish and **121** French ads, none for Computer


## How Perplexity's funnel is wired


Perplexity names its campaigns like a spreadsheet. The names travel in the ad links, so the whole media plan can be read from the outside.


### The campaign names


Campaign Ads What it buys


US_Meta_AllDevices_Comet-Download_StudentSignUp_Launch 85 Student signups, all to /grow/comet/students


E1_Meta_AllDevices_Comet_Launch_Download_Broad_Winners 67 Installs, first region


US_Meta_AllDevices_Comet_Launch_Download_Broad_Winners 38 Installs, US


E1_Meta_AllDevices_Comet_Launch_Activation_Broad_Winners 35 A first query from people who already installed


2025-Q4_PR_Meta_Traffic_Ronaldo 21 Traffic to the Ronaldo page


2025-Q4_UK_Meta_Traffic_Ronaldo 17 Same, UK


Read left to right: region, channel, device, product, phase, objective, audience, variant.


Two words matter. **Download** and **Activation** are separate campaigns. 110 ads buy the install. 39 buy the first query from people who installed and went quiet. Most apps optimize for the install and hope. Perplexity pays twice, on purpose.


**Winners** means the creative already won somewhere else. Ads get tested, and the ones that hold up graduate into a broad audience under a new campaign.


### Ronaldo was bought once and sliced


The athlete campaigns name their ad sets, and the ad sets are interests: Prospecting_Sports, Prospecting_Racing, Prospecting_Comedy, Prospecting_Broad, Prospecting_LALWebVisitors (a lookalike of site visitors), and one Retargeting. All over 18. One face, cut into audiences.


Creators went the other way. 23 of them got a campaign each in the Comet launch: YoungEmperors_Comet, ChefZem_Comet, IsobelLorna_Comet, Keladam_Comet. Their posts were boosted under names like Boost_HulettBros-Influencer_Video_90s_Learn - the creator's own 90-second post, still in the learning phase.


### One link for every device


284 of the 391 live Meta ads use a single attribution link, perplexity.sng.link/A6awk/lplb. A phone gets the app store, a desktop gets the download, and the campaign, ad set and creative names ride along. The web ads carry the same set of names on 1,039 ads.


That is how a team counts installs per creative without a landing page in the way.


Computer is the exception. It sells on 24 job landers under /gen/computer/, and some have a twin that skips the page and goes straight to sign-in: /gen/computer-base/ai-construction-estimating/signin. Lander vs no lander, tested per job.


**Buy the install and the first use separately.** If activation is the problem, give it its own campaign, its own budget and its own name.


## How Perplexity pays people to promote it


The referral program runs on Dub. Perplexity bought Meta ads to recruit for it: 5 ads send people to its partner signup page.


The payout has been reported at $15 for each US referral who downloads Comet, signs in and asks a first question, lower in other countries, and up to $20 per student signup on a campus track. LinkedIn creators carry their own short links, like pplx.ai/leah-agar1.


Students have their own track. Campus partners are paid in cash for referrals, Spaces and events on campus, through the same Dub rails. And the creator side is staffed like a media budget: the job post for Perplexity's creator and influencer lead talks about "campaigns spanning 100+ creators and multi-million-dollar budgets".


Put it next to the campaign names. The Activation campaigns buy a first query. The affiliate payout pays for a first query. The student bounty pays for a first query.


Three budgets, one event.


## Two launches, and a gap


### Comet in autumn 2025, Computer in summer 2026


Month Ads launched What it was


Sep 2025 127 Comet browser (79), unlimited cited answers


Oct 2025 783 Comet (754), "Free for you for a limited time"


Nov 2025 162 Search, 159 ads


Dec 2025 94 Ronaldo lander, 50 ads


Jan to Jul 2026 193 Computer from March, 28 to 35 a month


Aug 2026 182 Computer launch, 159 ads


Sep 2026 199 Computer, task landers, creators


Oct 2026 (to the 12th) 22 Computer, 21 ads


Look at the bursts and then look at what is between them. Perplexity does not drip. It holds, then ships. 783 ads in October 2025 alone, 270 of them in the busiest week ever (week 41 of 2025). Then 381 in August and September 2026. 167 launched in the last 30 days, and the busiest week of 2026 was week 35 with 104.


### Comet was given away


Comet ran on a free offer. 747 of 836 Comet ads say free. 85 ads send people to a students page, and 36 are headlined "100% free for students". 58 more say "Students: Unlock Perplexity Pro + Comet early - free for a limited time". 111 are headlined "Free for you for a limited time".


One of 85 Comet student-offer ads. 13 October 2026.


Free to students is an acquisition trade. Perplexity is buying the habit before the job. The median Comet ad lived 6 days, and 532 of the 836 ended within a week. Nothing from that burst is live.


## Computer: the product behind the product


### Given away vs sold


Measure Comet Computer Search


Meta ads 836 508 431


Live now 0 334 57


Ads that say free 747 (89%) 26 (5%) 188 (44%)


Not in English 258 (31%) 0 188 (44%)


Median life of an ended ad 6 days 39 days 12 days


On partner and creator pages 37 (4%) 93 (18%) 43 (10%)


Comet was a download. Free, translated, short-lived. Computer is a purchase. English only, creators on it, and the ads stay up. The free offer is gone and the lander is doing the work.


### The copy describes work, not search


Three bodies carry most of the Computer account. "Computer automates work end-to-end. Research, build, and deploy from a single prompt." runs on 99 ads. A longer "Chat gives you answers. Agents can run a task. Computer executes entire workflows" runs on 88. A Shopify version, "20+ AI models run your Shopify store", runs on 79.


That is 266 ads on three bodies. 111 ads mention Shopify. "Your AI team for Shopify" and "Scale your DTC brand with AI" are headlines in their own right.


Perplexity is not selling a better answer box. It is selling a teammate you delegate to.


### Personas expressed as jobs


Most brands pick an audience and write to it. Perplexity picks a task and builds a page for it. 166 ads send to a URL under /gen/, and each URL is one job. 95 of those ads are live.


Lander Ads


job-applications 47


construction-estimate 21


property-analysis 12


video-to-shorts, computer/main 10 each


seo 9


shopify-store, youtube-channel-optimization 6 each


grant-finder 5


find-angels, ai-seo, personal-brand-strategy, real estate, construction estimating 4 each


poshmark-audit, slack, daily-brief, signal-inbox 3 each


data-enricher, sponsor-sourcing and four others 1 to 2 each


Job applications is the biggest task lander: 47 ads.


"Get found by recruiters." "Blueprints in. Bid-ready estimates out." Nobody is told they are a job seeker or an estimator. The ad names the work and the right person recognises it. Persona by task.


Construction estimate: 21 ads, plus 4 more on a separate estimating lander.


## Where the ads send people


### The app, mostly


Destination Ads


perplexity.ai/grow/comet landers 828


perplexity.sng.link app deep link 578


/gen/ task landers 166


Google Play listing 90


perplexity.ai/ronaldo 50


Perplexity home page 32


578 ads, a third of the account, use one app deep link. 349 of them are Computer ads, and it is on 73% of the live ads. Tap the ad and the Perplexity app opens, on the right screen, instead of a web page that asks you to download something. Both iOS and Android paths are in the link.


### Faces on one launch, creators on the next


Ronaldo got his own lander and 50 ads in December 2025, headlined "Greatness begins with a question." and "Explore the CR7 Experience only on Perplexity". All 50 have ended. Lewis Hamilton ran 6 ads on a partner page, with "Don't go Plex for Plex with me". Across 80 athlete ads, none sold Computer.


The Ronaldo campaign: 50 ads, one lander, December 2025.


For Computer the faces are creators, not athletes. 173 ads run on 66 partner pages. 93 of them sell Computer, 18% of its ads against 4% for Comet: Cristina Cataman (13), Anton Mehto (10), Financial Wolf (9), Landon Bytheway (8), Edward Sun (6), Sam Parr (4). The copy is a creator workflow: "How I’d run a newsletter - with Perplexity Computer. Comment COMPUTER and I'll send you details." The call to action is a comment, and 32 ads ask for it.


**Athletes sell the brand. Creators sell the use case.** Perplexity switched casts when the product changed from an answer engine to a worker.


### Free gets translated. The worker does not.


The free offers ran in five languages: 292 ads in Spanish, 121 in French, 46 in Italian, 33 in German and 33 in Polish. Mostly the Comet free offer and "Unlimited. Cited. Free." translated line for line: "Ilimitado. Con Fuentes. Gratis." and "Illimité. Avec Sources. Gratuit." All 508 Computer ads are English.


"Illimité. Avec Sources. Gratuit." One of 121 French ads.


## Short lives


1,384 Meta ads have ended. The median one ran 8 days. 1,058 ran 14 days or fewer. 682 ran a week or less.


Measure Value


Ended ads 1,384


Median life of an ended ad 8 days


Ended within 14 days 1,058


Ended within 7 days 682


Median life, Comet / Computer 6 / 39 days


Median age of a live ad 42 days


Oldest live ad started 24 April 2026


Eight days is fast, and Comet drags it down. Perplexity tests, kills and replaces. The ads that survive get a long run: Computer ads that ended lasted 39 days, and the oldest live one started in April. And 166 distinct copy combinations sit behind 1,775 ads, so the same message gets cut a lot of ways.


## LinkedIn and Google


The business buyer lives off Meta.


### LinkedIn: 1,398 ads, Computer for the enterprise


Ad type Ads


Single image 694


Video 261


Message ad 218


Document ad 186


Spotlight, carousel and others 39


713 of the 1,398 mention Computer. "Book a demo." is the headline on 133 ads, and 287 name finance or buyside: "Perplexity Computer for Buyside Institutions" (22), "Perplexity Computer for Professional Finance" (24). The rest sell Perplexity Enterprise to named functions: "See how IT leaders govern AI with Perplexity" (17), "See how legal teams run cited research" (11), "See how ops teams save hours with Perplexity" (6). Document ads carry a statistic: "Only 23% of organizations have scaled AI. See the 7 practices behind Perplexity deployments hitting 80%+ adoption." (15)


The one giveaway is $80 in credits, on 103 ads. Everything else asks for a demo.


Same pattern as Meta: the buyer is a role and the product is a job. 1,253 of the 1,398 are posted by Perplexity itself.


### Google: 345 ads, Computer and the API


270 text, 43 image and 32 video ads, shown from April to September 2026. 295 land on the Perplexity home page. Headlines are product names: "Perplexity Computer" (32), "Perplexity API Platform" (9), "Introducing Computer" (7), "Your 24/7 Digital Worker" (6). A description reads "One subscription, every top model. GPT, Claude, and Gemini together." Ads show in the US plus France, Germany, Spain, Italy and the Netherlands.


## What actually makes this work


The product changed, so the ads changed with it. A search company that keeps selling search is competing with Google. A company selling a worker is competing for a salary line.


The price changed with it. Comet needed installs, so it was free, translated and gone in 6 days. Computer needs budget, so it is English, creator-fronted and runs for weeks.


Perplexity does not argue the case in one ad. It builds a lander per job and lets the buyer find theirs. Job applications, estimates, property analysis, Shopify. Each one is a small, specific promise.


The 8-day median says the account is a test bench. Nothing is precious. The winners are the ones still running in October.


What I would copy is the sequencing: one big launch, a hold, then 381 ads in two months. And the offer matched to the product. Free for the install, a lander per job for the sale.
